notes.title: Project Soulflow HD update
notes.content:
after people playing it who said it was too confusing, I finally fixed the game up to make it easier for everyone, especially new players!

[b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] added bloody text on the walls that guides you through the start of the game
[*] added proper stealth, as well as fixing up the buggy raycasts (it's a wonder they used to work at all) so vision works flawlessly now
[*] added post processing to the menus
[*] added the ability to turn your torch on/off using "R", which makes you impossible to see by monsters (they can still hear you)
[*] made crouching make enemy's hearing much lower, so you can sneak right past them
[*] added music to the end screen
[*] fixed the map and sensitivity issue in the second level
[*] changed the large cog room's soul switch to make a bridge instead of floating platforms
[/list]

[b]the big one[/b] - next update will hopefully include a level editor!

notes.title: PROJECT SOULFLOW: SHARED SUFFERING
notes.content:
[h1]After 4 months of development, the multiplayer update is finally here![/h1]


[h2]CONTENT:[/h2]
Explore the randomly generated maps with your friends, fixing the containment units to contain the abominations VSP has created!

Escape the facility car park in the second story level, with the new enemy "gremlin" joining the chase to hunt you down as you run from the VSP corporation

[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS:[/h2]
finally, the game has achievements!
these entail:
[list]
[*]Escapist - escape the lab
[*]On the Run - escape the facility car park
[*]A Quick Performance - beat the first level in under 175 seconds
[*]Car Chase - beat the second level in under 150 seconds 
[*]Here we go... - attempt the first level
[*]Shared Suffering - fix 3 containment units in the multiplayer mode
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*]glitch with the player model moving around in soul mode fixed, as well as a change to the player model
[*]glitch which made you teleport under the map and be unable to move upon going into soul mode was fixed
[*]QOL/balancing fixes with minor adjustments to object positioning
[*]fixed bug with the object sets script which made the hammer never spawn, making levels impossible to complete
[/list]
